description: This file implements the HttpNoVarySearchData class, which manages and compares URL search parameters based on 'no-vary' and 'vary' rules, including parsing from HTTP headers.

classes.name: HttpNoVarySearchData
classes.description: Class managing URL search parameter variation rules, including parsing from headers and comparison of URLs based on 'no-vary' and 'vary' criteria.

methods.name: AreEquivalent
methods.description: Compares two URLs to determine if they are equivalent based on the no-vary and vary rules.

methods.name: CreateFromNoVaryParams
methods.description: Creates an instance with specified no-vary parameters and key order variation setting.

methods.name: CreateFromVaryParams
methods.description: Creates an instance with specified vary parameters and key order variation setting.

methods.name: ParseFromHeaders
methods.description: Parses the 'No-Vary-Search' header from HTTP response headers to create an instance.

methods.name: no_vary_params
methods.description: Returns the set of parameters that should not vary.

methods.name: vary_params
methods.description: Returns the set of parameters that are allowed to vary.

methods.name: vary_on_key_order
methods.description: Indicates whether the order of keys affects URL equivalence.

methods.name: vary_by_default
methods.description: Indicates whether parameters vary by default.
